The front left wheel appears slightly distorted; the tire sidewall blends into the fender/wheel well area without a sharp boundary, suggesting minor geometric instability.
Significant blurring/softness compared to the rest of the image, potentially masking facial feature inconsistencies or generation errors.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the vehicle is correctly classified as a golf cart and not a similar utility vehicle or car.
To verify the spatial relationship between the cart, the passengers, and the background trees, ensuring no floating elements or depth bleeding.
To check for clean boundaries around the wheels and undercarriage, detecting any fusion with the ground or shadow artifacts.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the driver's hands on the steering wheel. AI often fails here. Check if the fingers are distinct or if they merge into the plastic. Also, inspect the front wheel arches for any 'melting' where the tire meets the bodywork. Verify that the golf bags in the back have distinct straps and don't blend into the seat backs.
